subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this remain the canonical Google Chat Space @mention ingress bug, and should a code fix wait for fresh live Space proof rather than a source-only repair?
rationale: Current main and v2026.6.11 contain the classifier fix, but the remaining failure depends on live Google Chat annotation metadata and could be solved as mention-detection repair, diagnostics, or consolidation with adjacent Space routing work.

options.title: Keep Canonical With Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical mentioned-Space drop bug and require redacted live proof plus focused regression coverage before promoting a fix.

options.title: Split A Narrow Mention Bug
options.body: Open or designate a narrower Google Chat mention-detection issue and leave this one as the user-facing umbrella until that narrower item lands.

options.title: Consolidate With Space Routing
options.body: Move the remaining requirement under the broader Google Chat Space routing discussion if maintainers want one combined product boundary for ingress and thread metadata.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical With Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical mentioned-Space drop bug and require redacted live proof plus focused regression coverage before promoting a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc landed the related classifier fix and has the strongest recent maintainer-context signal for deciding whether the remaining Space behavior is canonical or should be split.
